arXiv:1310.0103.abstract: We show that Hecke algebra of type $B$ and a coideal subalgebra of the type $A$ quantum group satisfy a double centralizer property, generalizing the Schur-Jimbo duality in type $A$. The quantum group of type $A$ and its coideal subalgebra form a quantum symmetric pair. A new theory of canonical bases arising from quantum symmetric pairs is initiated. It is then applied to formulate and establish
